transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I just don’t care about the things I used to look forward to. My fishing gear’s been sitting untouched in the garage, and going into the woodshop feels like a chore now. Even when my kids ask me to play chess, I’m just going through the motions.
How long have you been feeling this lack of interest in your usual activities?
About a year and seven months now. It started around when my wife’s health problems changed everything at home.
Along with losing interest in things, have you been feeling sad, down, or empty most of the day?
I’m not really sure how to label it. I mostly just know I don’t feel like myself, and nothing seems worth much effort anymore.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt unusually energized, wired, or hyperactive?
I’m not sure what you mean by that. I haven’t really noticed anything like that.
Before this started about a year and a half ago, had you ever gone through a time in your life when you felt like this?
I don’t know. I can’t really think of another time like this before.
How has your sleep been during this time?

I’m exhausted when I get into bed, but I can’t always fall asleep. My mind just runs through bills and schedules. Or I wake up around three or four and lie there staring at the ceiling until it’s time to drive to the site.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over this past year or so?

Yeah. Most food just tastes like cardboard lately. I skip breakfast a lot and barely pick at dinner, even after being on the site all day. My belt’s had to come in a couple notches, and I wasn’t trying to lose weight.
With everything feeling so heavy, have you had any thoughts that life isn't worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Yeah… on those early drives, before anybody else is awake, I sometimes think it’d be easier if I just didn’t make it there. And I’ve caught myself thinking about steering off the road. That scares me, because it feels too close.
During this past year and seven months, have you had any periods lasting two months or more where you felt like your normal self?
No. It’s been about a year and seven months now, since my wife’s health problems changed everything at home. I haven’t really felt like my normal self for any stretch like that.
